values: STUDENT EVALUATION — WEIGHTED MEAN & VERBAL INTERPRETATION WORKSHEET (ISO/IEC 25010)

HOW TO USE: Tally each physical survey and type the counts into the yellow cells (Rating 4–1) for every question. N, Total Score, Weighted Mean, and Verbal Interpretation calculate automatically — do not type into those columns. "Overall Category Mean" is the average of that category's item means; the bottom row is the average across all 5 categories. Row 6 (Q1) is pre-filled with the worked example from your own guide (30 Strongly Agree + 10 Agree, n=40) so you can see the formulas working — overwrite B6:E6 with your real tally first.
1. The system effectively meets the functional requirement of verifying my student identity using NFC, PIN, and QR codes.
2. The system performs the attendance and entry verification tasks accurately and completely.
3. The features of the system are highly relevant to the problem of monitoring student attendance and campus entry.
4. The system provides appropriate outputs (e.g., visual or audio confirmation) when I input my credentials.
5. The overall functionality successfully aligns with the objective of providing a secure attendance system.
1. The system responds quickly when I tap my NFC card, enter my PIN, or scan my QR code.
2. The system performs well and verifies my entry smoothly even when there is a long line of students.
3. The system maintains consistent verification speed and performance throughout the entire entry process.
4. The overall speed and performance of the system meet my expectations for an attendance process.
1. The physical interface of the verification terminal (keypad, scanner, screen) is intuitive and easy to navigate.
2. The system provides clear instructions and feedback on what step to do next (e.g., when to tap or scan).
3. The design and layout of the verification terminal enhance my overall user experience.
4. I was able to learn how to operate the system (tap, PIN, scan) with minimal to no training.
5. The system supports accessibility and is straightforward enough to be used by all types of students.
1. The system processes my verification consistently without unexpected failures or freezing.
2. If a minor error occurs (e.g., wrong PIN entered), the system allows me to recover easily and try again.
3. I trust that the system accurately records and maintains the integrity of my attendance data.
4. The system successfully reads my inputs under different physical conditions (e.g., fast tapping, minor screen glare).
5. The system demonstrates stable performance from the start to the end of my verification process.
1. The system effectively protects my personal attendance data from unauthorized viewing by others in line.
2. The two-factor authentication (PIN and QR) successfully confirms my true identity.
3. I feel confident that my sensitive credentials (NFC, PIN, QR) are handled securely during verification.
4. The system's design includes measures that prevent common threats, such as others copying or stealing my credentials.
5. The multi-factor process successfully maintains the confidentiality and security of my campus entry.
SECURITY PERSONNEL EVALUATION — WEIGHTED MEAN & VERBAL INTERPRETATION WORKSHEET (ISO/IEC 25010)

HOW TO USE: Tally each physical survey and type the counts into the yellow cells (Rating 4–1) for every question. N, Total Score, Weighted Mean, and Verbal Interpretation calculate automatically — do not type into those columns. "Overall Category Mean" is the average of that category's item means; the bottom row is the average across all 5 categories. Row 6 (Q1) is pre-filled with the worked example from your own guide (30 Strongly Agree + 10 Agree, n=40) so you can see the formulas working — overwrite B6:E6 with your real tally first.
1. The system provides me with the necessary on-screen information (e.g., student name, ID number, entry status) to accurately verify the identities of individuals entering the campus.
2. The security dashboard correctly logs and displays real-time entry records as students pass through the gate.
3. The monitoring features provided by the system are highly relevant to my daily tasks of controlling campus entry and identifying unverified individuals.
4. The system provides clear visual or audio alerts on the monitoring screen when access is either successfully granted or denied.
5. The overall functionality successfully supports security personnel in enforcing gate protocols more effectively than traditional methods.
1. The monitoring screen updates immediately without lag when a student taps their card or enters their PIN at the terminal.
2. The dashboard handles rapid, successive entries smoothly, allowing me to continuously monitor a fast-moving queue without system slowdowns.
3. The system maintains a consistent response time and screen performance throughout my shift or the entire evaluation period.
4. The speed at which the system processes entries and alerts me to potential issues meets my expectations for an efficient gate monitoring process.
1. The layout of the security monitoring screen is organized, intuitive, and easy to read at a quick glance.
2. The system effectively highlights critical information (e.g., using clear color codes like green for "Pass" and red for "Denied") so I know exactly when to intervene.
3. I was able to learn how to monitor the dashboard and interpret system alerts with minimal to no training.
4. The student information (e.g., Name, ID Number, Status) displayed on the monitoring screen is clear and easy to read from a comfortable standing distance.
5. Navigating the security interface is straightforward enough to be used efficiently by all assigned security personnel, regardless of technical background.
1. The security monitoring dashboard runs consistently without unexpected freezing, crashing, or losing connection.
2. If a minor sync error occurs between the terminal and the monitor, the interface recovers quickly without disrupting the monitoring of the gate.
3. I trust that the alerts and statuses displayed on my screen accurately reflect what is happening at the student terminal in real-time.
4. The system reliably and consistently flags suspicious activities (e.g., repeated failed PIN attempts) every time they occur during testing.
5. The system demonstrates stable and dependable monitoring capabilities from the start to the end of the evaluation process.
1. The monitoring screen displays only the necessary student information to me, preventing the unnecessary exposure of their private data to bystanders.
2. The system provides me with enough reliable data to confidently confirm if the person at the gate is the true owner of the credentials.
3. I feel confident relying on the system's alerts to prevent unauthorized individuals or outsiders from bypassing the gate.
4. The system effectively detects and alerts me to common security threats, such as students passing back IDs for others to use.
5. The implementation of this system enhances the overall physical security of the campus compared to traditional visual-check methods.
FACULTY/ EVENT ORGANIZER/ ADMIN EVALUATION — WEIGHTED MEAN & VERBAL INTERPRETATION WORKSHEET (ISO/IEC 25010)

HOW TO USE: Tally each physical survey and type the counts into the yellow cells (Rating 4–1) for every question. N, Total Score, Weighted Mean, and Verbal Interpretation calculate automatically — do not type into those columns. "Overall Category Mean" is the average of that category's item means; the bottom row is the average across all 5 categories. Row 6 (Q1) is pre-filled with the worked example from your own guide (30 Strongly Agree + 10 Agree, n=40) so you can see the formulas working — overwrite B6:E6 with your real tally first.
1. The dashboard provides all necessary features to successfully create, configure, and manage university events.
2. The system effectively categorizes and generates accurate attendance records by College, Section, Year Level, and specific Event.
3. The system allows me to easily configure and switch between different verification modes as required for specific events or gate protocols.
4. The centralized monitoring and alert functions provide relevant and accurate information for administrative oversight.
5. Overall, the system's administrative features completely align with the needs of event organizers and faculty members.
1. The centralized dashboard loads quickly and reflects real-time gate and event attendance data without noticeable delay.
2. Generating complex attendance reports (e.g., filtering by multiple categories) is processed and completed in a reasonable amount of time.
3. The system handles multiple administrative actions smoothly, even when receiving rapid data inputs from the verification terminals.
4. The dashboard maintains consistent performance and does not slow down when processing or storing large amounts of attendance data.
5. The overall speed of the backend system meets my expectations for efficient event and attendance management.
1. The exported attendance reports (e.g., CSV, Excel, PDF) are fully compatible with standard office software used by the university.
2. The system operates smoothly without negatively interfering with other existing administrative software or network tools.
3. The generated data is structured in a way that could easily be integrated with existing university databases in the future.
4. The system performs consistently regardless of the type of computer or operating system I use to access the admin dashboard.
1. The layout and navigation menus of the centralized dashboard are logical, well-organized, and easy to understand.
2. The process of generating reports and filtering attendance lists is straightforward and does not require complex steps.
3. I am able to create a new event, assign verification modes, and launch the monitoring screen with minimal effort.
4. The system provides clear visual feedback or error messages if I input incomplete or incorrect settings during event creation.
5. I would require very minimal training to confidently use all the administrative functions of this system.
1. The centralized dashboard operates consistently without unexpected crashes, freezing, or downtime during active monitoring.
2. All configured event settings and recorded attendance data are saved securely without unexpected loss of records.
3. In the event of a minor disruption (e.g., a brief internet drop), the dashboard recovers quickly and resumes synchronization properly.
4. I can trust the system to accurately reflect exactly what is happening at the verification terminals without data discrepancies.
5. The administrative system demonstrates a high level of stability from setup to the conclusion of the event evaluation.
1. The system requires proper authentication (e.g., secure admin login) before granting access to the centralized dashboard.
2. Administrative privileges are strictly enforced, ensuring unauthorized users or students cannot alter event settings or attendance records.
3. Sensitive student data within the attendance database is adequately protected from unauthorized viewing or extraction.
4. The system architecture prevents common data manipulations, ensuring that generated attendance reports are legitimate and untampered.
5. I feel confident that the system provides a secure environment for managing university-level event data.
1. The source code is clean, well-structured, and easy to read, following standard coding guidelines and best practices.
2. The codebase is thoroughly documented with clear comments and technical documentation, making it easy for other developers to understand and navigate.
3. The system architecture uses modular design principles (e.g., separated components, reusable functions) that make it easy to isolate and update specific features.
4. The code allows for seamless debugging, error logging, and troubleshooting when identifying and fixing software bugs or system issues.
5. Future updates, modifications, or scaling of the system can be implemented with minimal effort and without breaking existing core functionalities.
1. The dashboard can be easily accessed from different devices (e.g., desktop PC or laptop) without losing essential functionality.
2. The system interface adapts well to different monitor screen sizes and resolutions in various university offices.
3. Accessing the administrative system on a new computer requires no complex installations or difficult setup procedures.
4. The system is flexible enough to be deployed and managed for events located in different buildings or areas across the campus.
5. Transitioning the management of the system from one administrative user environment to another is a seamless process.
PRE-EVALUATION (MANUAL) — WEIGHTED MEAN & VERBAL INTERPRETATION WORKSHEET (ISO/IEC 25010)

HOW TO USE: Tally each physical survey and type the counts into the yellow cells (Rating 4–1) for every question. N, Total Score, Weighted Mean, and Verbal Interpretation calculate automatically — do not type into those columns. "Overall Category Mean" is the average of that category's item means; the bottom row is the average across all 5 categories. Row 6 (Q1) is pre-filled with the worked example from your own guide (30 Strongly Agree + 10 Agree, n=40) so you can see the formulas working — overwrite B6:E6 with your real tally first.
1. The manual process provides a clear way to verify my identity when attending a university event.
2. The manual process accurately and completely records my entry information.
3. The paper-based attendance procedures are relevant to monitoring student attendance.
4. The manual process provides clear confirmation that my attendance has been recorded (e.g., staff confirmation or completed sign-in).
5. Overall, the manual process meets the basic requirements for recording event attendance.
1. The manual process is completed quickly when I sign the attendance sheet.
2. The manual process remains manageable even when there is a long line of students.
3. The manual process maintains a consistent processing speed throughout the attendance procedure.
4. The overall speed of the manual process meets my expectations for event attendance.
1. The steps for paper sign-in are easy to understand and follow.
2. The instructions provided by the event staff clearly explain what I need to do.
3. The arrangement of the sign-in sheet, identification-checking procedure, and related materials makes the process easy to use.
4. I can complete the paper sign-in process with minimal or no assistance.
5. The manual process is straightforward enough to be used by students with different levels of familiarity with the procedure.
1. My attendance is recorded consistently without being missed, duplicated, or improperly recorded.
2. If an error occurs in the written information or identity check, it can be corrected before the record is finalized.
3. I trust that the paper attendance sheet or manual record accurately reflects my attendance.
4. The manual process can still be completed under different physical conditions, such as crowded queues or limited writing space.
5. The manual verification and attendance process remains stable from the beginning to the end of the procedure.
1. The manual process limits unnecessary exposure of my personal information on attendance sheets.
2. Manual identity checking provides enough information to verify that the person presenting the identification is the rightful student.
3. I feel confident that my student and attendance information is handled securely during the manual process.
4. The manual process includes measures that help prevent common problems such as proxy attendance, or unauthorized signing.
5. The attendance process adequately protects the confidentiality and security of event attendance information.
